note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; alate, soldier and worker are all described; measurement-table headings, figure numbers, synonyms, literature citations and distribution are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale to dark brown; antennae brown, gradually darker towards the apex; pronotum pale straw-coloured; legs and abdomen milky white. Pilosity sparse on the head, denser on the body. Body length 3.9–5.3 mm. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly; 1.0–1.45 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.90–1.15 mm maximum width; width of mandible base 0.55–0.68 mm; width-length index 0.73–0.95; ratio of mandible-base width to maximum width 0.55–0.64. Antennae 16–17-segmented; with 16 segments, segment 4 shortest; with 17 segments, segments 3 and 5 subequal and shortest. Labrum ligulate, narrowed anteriorly to a narrowly rounded apex; 0.35 mm long, 0.30 mm wide. Mandibles long and slender, nearly straight, only the tips slightly incurved, two-thirds to three-quarters of the head length; 0.78–0.90 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.62–0.78. Left mandible with a minute tooth above the apical third; tooth 0.20–0.25 mm from the tip; ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.28–0.31. Right mandible with a vestigial tooth at the apical third. Postmentum subrectangular, sides convex; 0.65–0.80 mm long, 0.40–0.50 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; 0.45–0.55 mm long, 0.70–0.85 mm wide; anterior margin deeply notched, posterior margin weakly to distinctly incurved at the middle.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head capsule dark straw-coloured; antennae, postclypeus and pronotum slightly paler; abdomen nearly white. Pilosity dense on head and body. Body length 3.5–4.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; 1.2–1.55 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.40–1.74 mm maximum width. Antennae 17-segmented; segments 3 and 4 subequal. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, about half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; 0.33–0.50 mm long, 0.63–0.90 mm wide; anterior margin deeply notched, posterior margin straight with a shallow median notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; antennae brown; labrum and legs pale brown; dorsum of thorax and abdomen slightly paler than the head capsule, sternites pale brown; pilosity dense on head and body. Body length 27.8–30.0 mm with wings, 12.0–14.8 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular; 1.70–2.0 mm long to base of mandibles, 2.55–2.70 mm wide including compound eyes; Y-shaped suture absent. Fontanelle minute, punctiform, raised, surrounded by a paler area. Compound eyes large, subcircular; maximum diameter 0.75–0.80 mm, minimum diameter 0.65–0.70 mm. Ocelli suboval, medium-sized; long diameter 0.30–0.36 mm, short diameter 0.16–0.20 mm; distance to the compound eye about equal to the short diameter (0.18–0.20 mm). Antennae 19-segmented; segments 3 and 5 subequal and both shortest. Postclypeus strongly inflated, half as long as wide. Pronotum sub-trapezoidal; 1.13–1.30 mm long, 2.2–2.3 mm wide; with a pale T-shaped mark at the middle and a shoulder spot on each side; anterior margin wavy with a weak median notch; posterior margin nearly straight, slightly incurved at the middle. Wings long and brown; fore wing 25–27 mm long, hind wing 22.5–25.5 mm long; radial trace separating from the radius at about the apical third.
